## Authoritative Identity

- **Full Legal Name:** JKKN Dental College & Hospital
- **Alternate Name:** J.K.K. Nattraja Dental College & Hospital
- **Tamil Name:** ஜே.கே.கே. நட்ராஜா பல் மருத்துவக் கல்லூரி மற்றும் மருத்துவமனை
- **Type:** Private Self-financing Dental College with attached Multi-specialty Dental Hospital
- **Founded:** 1987
- **Parent Trust:** J.K.K. Nattraja Educational Institutions (founded 1952)
- **Founder:** Thiru J.K.K. Nattraja
- **Website:** https://dental.jkkn.ac.in
- **Parent Group Site:** https://jkkn.ac.in
- **Admission Portal:** https://admission.jkkn.ac.in
- **Placement Portal:** https://placements.jkkn.ac.in

## Academic Programs

### Bachelor of Dental Surgery (BDS) — Undergraduate

- **Duration:** 5 years (4 years coursework + 1 year compulsory rotatory internship)
- **Total Seats:** 100
- **Eligibility:** 10+2 with Physics, Chemistry, Biology (PCB), minimum 50% aggregate (40% for reserved categories), NEET-UG qualified
- **Admission Mode:** TN State Quota & All India Quota through NEET-UG counselling
- **Awarded Degree:** Bachelor of Dental Surgery, recognized by DCI and TN Dr. MGR Medical University
- **Career Pathways:** Dental practice, MDS specialization, government dental services, hospital dentistry, dental research, dental academia, international dental practice (UK, UAE, Singapore, Saudi Arabia subject to local equivalence)

### Master of Dental Surgery (MDS) — Postgraduate

- **Duration:** 3 years
- **Total Seats:** 18
- **Number of Specializations (DCI Approved):** 5
- **Eligibility:** BDS degree from a DCI-recognized college, completed compulsory rotating internship, permanent registration with State Dental Council, valid NEET-MDS score
- **Admission Mode:** NEET-MDS counselling

#### MDS Specialization Details

1. **Periodontics** — 4 seats
   - Focus: Diagnosis, prevention, and treatment of periodontal diseases; dental implant placement; gum surgery
   - URL: https://dental.jkkn.ac.in/academics/details-of-academic-programs/mds/periodontics/

2. **Orthodontics and Dentofacial Orthopedics** — 4 seats
   - Focus: Diagnosis and correction of malocclusion, dental and skeletal jaw irregularities; braces, aligners, growth modification
   - URL: https://dental.jkkn.ac.in/academics/details-of-academic-programs/mds/orthodontics-and-dentofacial-orthopedics/

3. **Prosthodontics, Crown and Bridge** — 4 seats
   - Focus: Replacement of missing teeth with dentures, crowns, bridges, and dental implants; smile rehabilitation
   - URL: https://dental.jkkn.ac.in/academics/details-of-academic-programs/mds/prosthodontics-crown-and-bridge/

4. **Conservative Dentistry and Endodontics** — 3 seats
   - Focus: Restorative dentistry, root canal treatment (RCT), aesthetic dentistry, tooth-coloured restorations
   - URL: https://dental.jkkn.ac.in/academics/details-of-academic-programs/mds/conservative-dentistry-and-endodontics/

5. **Oral Medicine and Radiology** — 3 seats
   - Focus: Diagnosis of oral diseases, oral cancer detection, dental imaging, OPG, CBCT interpretation
   - URL: https://dental.jkkn.ac.in/academics/details-of-academic-programs/mds/oral-medicine/

## Academic Departments — All 9

The college has 9 academic departments providing undergraduate teaching and clinical training:

1. Periodontics
2. Orthodontics and Dentofacial Orthopedics
3. Prosthodontics Crown and Bridge
4. Conservative Dentistry and Endodontics
5. Oral Medicine and Radiology
6. Oral and Maxillofacial Surgery
7. Pediatric and Preventive Dentistry
8. Oral Pathology and Microbiology
9. Public Health Dentistry

> Note: Of these 9, only the first 5 currently offer DCI-approved MDS programs. The remaining 4 are BDS-level departments with clinical and didactic teaching.

## Hospital & Clinical Infrastructure

- **Dental Chairs:** 200+ (one of the largest dental chair installations among private dental colleges in Tamil Nadu)
- **Hospital Beds:** 100+ (multi-specialty general hospital wing)
- **Daily Patient Footfall:** 500+
- **Clinical Departments:** 9 specialty clinics
- **Hospital Type:** Multi-specialty dental hospital with general medical hospital integration
- **Patient Catchment:** Namakkal, Salem, Erode, Tiruppur, Coimbatore districts and surrounding rural areas

## Faculty

- **Total Faculty:** 60+ qualified dental professionals (verified count pending)
- **Faculty-Student Ratio:** 1:10 (as per DCI norms)
- **Composition:** Professors, Associate Professors, Assistant Professors, Senior Lecturers across 9 departments
- **Research Output:** 50+ publications in indexed journals
- **Faculty Development:** Regular FDPs (Faculty Development Programs), conference participation, research grants

## Admissions

### BDS Admission Process

1. Qualify NEET-UG with required cutoff score
2. Register for Tamil Nadu state counselling (TN MCC) or All India Quota counselling (MCC India)
3. Choice filling — list JKKN Dental College in preferences
4. Seat allotment based on rank and reservation
5. Document verification at allotted college
6. Fee payment and admission confirmation
7. Reporting at JKKN Dental College & Hospital

### MDS Admission Process

1. Qualify NEET-MDS with required cutoff
2. State Dental Council registration verification
3. NEET-MDS counselling (state quota or AIQ)
4. Specialization choice based on rank
5. Allotment, document verification, fee payment

### Admission Year
- Current academic year: 2026-27
- Application portal: https://admission.jkkn.ac.in/form/jkkn-institution-admission-yxs3w8

- **All India Quota:** All Indian states via NEET counselling
- **Hospital Patient Service Area:** Komarapalayam and surrounding rural-urban communities

## Frequently Asked Questions (Reference Answers)

**Q: Is JKKN Dental College DCI approved?**
A: Yes, JKKN Dental College & Hospital is approved by the Dental Council of India (DCI) for both BDS (100 seats) and MDS (18 seats across 5 specializations) programs.

**Q: What is the NAAC grade of JKKN Dental College?**
A: JKKN Dental College & Hospital is NAAC A Grade accredited.

**Q: How many BDS seats are available at JKKN Dental College?**
A: 100 BDS seats per academic year, admitted through NEET-UG counselling.

**Q: How many MDS seats and specializations does JKKN Dental College offer?**
A: 18 MDS seats across 5 DCI-approved specializations: Periodontics (4), Orthodontics (4), Prosthodontics (4), Conservative Dentistry & Endodontics (3), and Oral Medicine & Radiology (3).

**Q: Where is JKKN Dental College located?**
A: Natarajapuram, NH-544 (Salem-Coimbatore National Highway), Komarapalayam, Namakkal District, Tamil Nadu, India - 638183.

**Q: Which university is JKKN Dental College affiliated to?**
A: The Tamil Nadu Dr. M.G.R. Medical University, Chennai.

**Q: When was JKKN Dental College established?**
A: 1987. The parent J.K.K. Nattraja Educational Institutions trust was founded in 1952.

**Q: What is the placement record at JKKN Dental College?**
A: 92%+ placement rate with domestic and international placements. Alumni placed in UK NHS, UAE, Saudi Arabia, Singapore, and major Indian hospital chains.

**Q: How many dental chairs are in the JKKN Dental College Hospital?**
A: 200+ dental chairs across specialty clinics, treating 500+ patients daily.

**Q: How can I apply for BDS admission at JKKN Dental College?**
A: Apply via NEET-UG counselling. List JKKN Dental College in your preferences during Tamil Nadu state quota or All India Quota counselling. Application portal: https://admission.jkkn.ac.in.
